newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU grain export commitments up on last year.
newsitem.headline: EU grain export commitments up on last year.

text.p: Latest European Union figures show grain export commitments between July 1, 1996, and January 21, 1997, were 42 percent above their year-ago level, mostly the result of higher wheat and barley sales, member-country officials said on Friday.
The figures, based on delivered export certificates, showed grain exports ahead on last year at 18.339 million tonnes against 12.911 million.
Commercial soft wheat export commitments reached 6.424 million tonnes, up from 4.3 million in the same period last year.
Commercial barley exports jumped to 3.724 million tonnes from 1.231 million during the same period last year, helped by sales to Saudi Arabia.
Flour exports were ahead on last year at 3.868 million tonnes against 3.017 million.
Malt exports rose to 2.568 million tonnes from 2.187 million.
Since January 21, the EU has authorised 71,900 tonnes of soft wheat, 75,000 tonnes of barley, 5,000 tonnes of rye, 34,500 tonnes of oats exports through its weekly grain tender system.
